text:
sara (AE): quick sync — HorizonPay wants a short pilot to validate transaction summarization + fraud-alert suggestions. they asked for a 4-week timeline and want clarity on success criteria, pricing, and security. can SEs weigh in?
sara (AE): key asks from them: 1) sample endpoints to integrate, 2) prompt examples + eval plan, 3) SLA/latency targets, 4) security questionnaire answers, 5) pricing for reserved vs on-demand during pilot.
devon (SE): happy to own integration. recommended endpoints: `/v1/chat` (streaming), `/v1/generate` (batched summaries), `/v1/embeddings` for fraud clustering.
devon (SE): integration notes: auth via API key in header; for VPC/private team we can do Private deployment but pilot likely on hosted with traffic routed to dedicated pool.
devon (SE): sample prompt we'd use for summarization (rough):
```
System: You are a transaction summarizer.
User: Summarize the transaction log for customer 12345: [raw txn list]. Include merchant, net amount, suspicious flags, and one-line recommended action.
```
devon (SE): for fraud alert suggestions we'd provide a small template + scored candidates. example output shape: `[{"alert": "possible chargeback","score":0.87, "rationale":"merchant mismatch + velocity"}]`
mike (Solutions Eng): propose success metrics: 1) summary accuracy >= 85% on our labeled 200-record eval, 2) avg 95th-percentile latency < 250ms for chat streaming, 3) cost under $X per 100k tokens (we'll compute once we know token counts).
mike (Solutions Eng): timeline suggestion (4 weeks):
- week 0: kickoff + infra access + small sample dataset (HorizonPay provides 500 real/pseudonymized txns)
- week 1: integration + basic prompt templates + smoke tests
- week 2: run baseline evals (accuracy + false positives on fraud)
additional:
- week 3: tuning (batching, quantization, routing) + perf tests
- week 4: final eval, runbook and handoff to HorizonPay engs

anya (Product): add quality guardrails: set up a regression prompt set (50 cases) they care about — e.g., multi-merchant payouts, refunds, cross-currency issues. we should capture top-3 failure modes and whether fallback to safe-response is acceptable.

kartik (Security): flagged items from their security questionnaire: SOC2 status, data residency, KMS/HSM usage, access controls, audit logs. I can draft answers but need clarifications: will HorizonPay send any PII? if yes, we need their DPA and expected retention windows.

kartik (Security): quick answers we can include: SOC2 Type II (yes), customer-managed KMS available for Private deployments, audit logs retained 90 days by default (longer with add-on). will confirm specifics for SOC attestation dates.

sara (AE): pricing question from their procurement: they want a pilot price that's capped and also an option to reserve a small Dedicated pool. they asked for a committed 2-month trial vs month-to-month.
sara (AE): any ballpark numbers we can give now for a 2x A100-equivalent reserved pool for pilot?
mike (Solutions Eng): ballpark — reserved small pool (1-2 GPUs) for pilot runs around $XXk/month depending on region and model; hosted on-demand cost will be token-based and typically ~30-50% higher per-unit for bursty traffic. i'll get finance a rough estimate.
sara (AE): ok — i'll tell procurement we'll provide a formal quote after we confirm token estimates and the model choice.

devon (SE): evaluation plan details: we want 3 datasets — `baseline` (200 labeled), `edge_cases` (50 tricky ones from anya), `live_stream` (anonymized real traffic sample). run metrics: precision/recall for fraud flags, F1 on summary labels, average token usage per txn.
devon (SE): quick eval script pseudo:
```
for item in baseline:
  pred = call_api("/v1/generate", prompt=item.prompt)
  score = compare(pred, item.gold)
  log(score, latency, tokens)
```

ops-bot: scheduled meeting created: "HorizonPay pilot kickoff" — Thu 2026-03-26 10:00 PT.

sara (AE): blockers we should call out to HorizonPay now: SSO/SAML for long-term access, any legal requirements for data deletion, and whether they need a private deployment (which adds 3-4 weeks).

anya (Product): on model selection — start with a medium-latency open model (quantized) for cost baseline, then run a higher-quality variant if accuracy < target. we'll document rollback policy and model variant mapping in the runbook.

kartik (Security): action item for me: I'll fill the security questionnaire draft by EOD Monday, but need HorizonPay contact to confirm PII. please add questions: expected retention, who can access data, and if they require external audit access.

mike (Solutions Eng): action item: I'll spin up a temporary dedicated pool for integration tests and share sample token burn numbers. need HorizonPay to share ~500 anonymized transactions by Monday.

sara (AE): next steps I will: 1) send kickoff invite (ops-bot did), 2) request sample dataset and questionnaire contact, 3) ask procurement for preferred quote cadence.

sara (AE): timeline note: if they require Private deployment, pilot extends to 8 weeks (adds infra + security review). otherwise hosted + small dedicated pool fits 4-week target.

devon (SE): final: can someone own the eval harness repo? i'll make an initial repo and invite the group — want to keep eval results reproducible.
sara (AE): thanks all — i'll collate these notes and share with HorizonPay after the kickoff. :thumbsup:
